sees: frame 1: A balding man with brown side hair, a black suit and bow tie stands in a pale room (picture frame, lamp, couch). A small dark book is at the bottom edge near his hand, partly cut off, resting on something wooden.
frame 2: Same room and man, slightly shifted. His left arm hangs out to the side. A small dark book sits on a wooden chair seat at the bottom right.

frame 3: Scene changed to an outdoor city background with grey buildings and a street lamp. The man stands larger, his right arm extended out toward a small dark open book on top of a wooden chair; his hand is not clearly touching it.
actor: a balding man in a black suit with a bow tie and brown side hair
object: a small dark book (possibly a notebook) on a wooden chair
before: in frame 1 the book is at the bottom edge beside the man, partly cropped, apparently resting on a chair
after: in frame 3 the book is on the wooden chair beside the man, who gestures toward it with an outstretched arm
change: The setting moves from an indoor room to an outdoor city street, and the man moves from standing near the book to gesturing toward it; the book itself stays on the chair.
consequence: Unclear; it suggests the man is presenting or pointing out the book or its contents, linking an indoor, private idea to the wider city or world.
message: The narrator seems to be saying that the man's written ideas (the book) matter or have an effect out in the wider world, but this is not clear from the image alone.
